notes.title: Patch v1.0.4
notes.notes:
- Added support for Dualsense (PS5) controllers
- Map variations now only appear once per match
- Fixed knockback direction bug when hitting boomerangs at point blank range
- A few small UI improvements

notes.title: First Patch v1.0.3
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue where points fell through the floor of certain maps, causing no more points to spawn
- FIxed issue where points would get stuck in obstacles
- Slightly tweaked difficulty of "Max Hit" achievement

notes.title: Bamerang Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
It has been more than 4.5 years since we created the very first prototype of Bamerang and it's a very special moment for us to finally release this first game of ours.

[b]Get ready to smack your friends with boomerangs, when Bamerang launches on April 22nd![/b]

If you haven't already, wishlist Bamerang! That would help us out a lot <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236490/Bamerang/

In the past year, we worked extensively to bring the game on the level of quality you deserve!
We squished the (hopefully) last bugs and ported the game to the Nintendo Switch. Meanwhile, the visuals were improved and juicy special effects were added. Our talented composer and sound designer spiced Bamerang up with a SFX overhaul and created super joyful soundtracks.
Thanks to lovely volunteers and a translation agency, the game will be available in various languages.

Thank you so much for your patience through all this time! We hope you are just as excited as us about Bamerang's release!

Drop by in our [url=https://discord.gg/x8sZEXy]Discord[/url] if you want to chat with us or other players :)

-Lululu Entertainment
